tagline.en_US: Create spreadsheet-backed databases, forms and team workspaces while keeping documents on a persistent local volume.

description.en_US: Grist is a relational spreadsheet application that combines the flexibility of a spreadsheet with the structure of a database. Named columns store typed data that can be dynamically populated using Python formulas or standard spreadsheet functions. It allows users to build drag-and-drop dashboards with linked widgets, summary tables, and charts. Data is kept in a portable, self-contained SQLite format that supports backups and native forms.
